items.t: Engine burns oil and low-oil warning comes on
items.job: Oil consumption test, top-offs and oil change
items.note: Diagnosis is covered under warranty. If internal engine repair is needed out of warranty, the cost is far higher.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason
items.job: Driver-assist sensor inspection, aiming and software update
items.note: Usually done free under warranty; replacing a radar or camera costs much more.

items.t: 12-volt battery drains and car won't start
items.job: Replace 12V start-stop battery and test for parasitic draw
items.note: Use the correct EFB/AGM battery for i-stop. YourMechanic lists about $182 for parts on average.

items.t: Sudden surge or lurch at low speed
items.job: Diagnostic scan and software update check

items.t: Hesitation or delayed shifting from the automatic
items.job: Transmission diagnosis and software reflash
items.note: A full transmission replacement is covered by the 5-year/60,000-mile powertrain warranty.

items.t: Engine stalls or loses power while driving
items.job: Diagnose stall and replace failed sensor
items.note: Parts depend on cause; a MAP or crank sensor is common.

items.t: Air conditioning stops blowing cold
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and recharge system
items.note: A leak repair or recharge alone is much cheaper. CarComplaints owners report about $1,600 on average.

items.t: Windshield cracks with no impact
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate front camera
items.note: Camera recalibration is required. CarComplaints owners report about $1,300.

items.t: Windshield looks wavy or distorted
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate front camera
items.note: May be covered under warranty if reported early.

items.t: Lane-keep or blind-spot system gives false alerts
items.job: Inspect and recalibrate camera or blind-spot radar
items.note: A new blind-spot sensor costs more; RepairPal lists backup warning sensor replacement around $1,150-$1,230.

items.t: Tire pressure warning or readings seem wrong
items.job: Set tire pressures and re-initialize TPMS

items.t: Sunroof glass shatters while driving
items.job: Replace sunroof glass panel

items.t: Rattles from the dashboard
items.job: Locate and secure loose dash trim

items.t: Creaking or clunking from the suspension at low speed
items.job: Replace sway bar links or bushings

items.t: Automatic high beams switch on and off by themselves
items.job: Camera inspection and recall check
items.note: Free if your car is covered by the forward camera recall.

items.t: Power liftgate may lower on its own (recall)
items.job: Update liftgate software, replace drive unit if needed
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten front caliper bolts
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Fuel vapor hose may be disconnected (recall)
items.job: Reconnect vent hose and replace charcoal canister
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Tire valve stems can suddenly leak (recall)
items.job: Replace all four tire valves
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: ABS control unit may be damaged (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace ABS hydraulic unit
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front camera fault disables emergency braking (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace forward sensing camera
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Airbags can switch off after a low battery (recall)
items.job: Reprogram or replace airbag sensor unit
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.
